response.sql: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS w FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS a FROM country_avg), grp AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.a), gavg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM grp) SELECT grp.country, grp.avg_wins, grp.avg_wins - o.a AS above_overall_avg, grp.avg_wins - gavg.g AS above_group_avg FROM grp, overall o, gavg WHERE grp.avg_wins > gavg.g ORDER BY grp.avg_wins DESC
